__comment: Mobs that do not drown. Until 1.20.1 these overrode LivingEntity#canBreatheUnderwater in code; 1.20.2 made that method final and reads this tag instead. WaterAnimal lost its own always-true override at the same boundary, which the fish never noticed (their handleAirSupply refills air in water) and the amphibious trilocaris, whose handleAirSupply is a deliberate no-op, did: it drowned underwater.
